QuestInfo.name: [The Afterlands] The Greatest of all Treasures
QuestInfo.0: Time has passed since the people of The Land of Riches left the castle, and their appearances have changed drastically! #p9400215# and #p9400216# have gone from sad, gaunt figures to healthy, chubby-faced individuals. Meanwhile, #p9400217# has returned to his old non-giant self. Talk to them!
QuestInfo.1:
Time has passed since the people of The Land of Riches left the castle, and their appearances have changed drastically! #p9400215# and #p9400216# have gone from sad, gaunt figures to healthy, chubby-faced individuals. Meanwhile, #p9400217# has returned to his old non-giant self.

#p9400217# says he shrank back down after 'purging' the treasures he'd eaten. He says that there is a #eGolden Key#n among the treasure that is yours for the taking. 
Look through the pile of treasures that #p9400217#... recycled.
QuestInfo.2: After #p9400215#, #p9400216# and #p9400217# stepped outside the castle walls, they realized that the riches that had once been so important to them were nothing at all. \r\nAs a result, #p9400215# and #p9400216# have gone from sad, gaunt figures to healthy, chubby-faced individuals. Meanwhile, #p9400217# has returned to his old non-giant self.\r\nAnd you discovered a #eGolden Key#n among the treasures that #p9400217# puked up!
